verdict.rationale: Square AI (Beta) is a first-party assistant built into the seller tools. Sellers can ask natural-language questions about their sales and inventory data, and it can pull in web context such as local weather, events and reviews. The vendor also says it can "handle routine tasks," but the documented examples and testimonials are all data analysis and insights, not delegated actions, and the feature is still in beta. Missing for 10: documented ability to execute actions or multi-step tasks on the seller's behalf, detail on which tasks can be delegated, general-availability status, independent or hands-on corroboration.
